# KoyJabo (কই যাবো) — Full Transit Intelligence & Research Document

# KoyJabo (কই যাবো) — Bangladesh Public Transport & Routing Intelligence

> KoyJabo is Bangladesh's premier multimodal transport guide, real-time routing platform, and travel intelligence system. We provide verified route maps, timetables, and government-approved fare structures for Dhaka city buses, Metro Rail (MRT Line-6), Bangladesh Railway intercity trains, river launches, domestic flights, and nationwide freight trucks.

- **Website**: [https://koyjabo.com](https://koyjabo.com)
- **Primary Coverage**: Dhaka Metropolitan Area, Narayanganj, Gazipur, Chattogram, Sylhet, Rajshahi, Khulna, Barishal, Rangpur.
- **Languages**: Bengali (বাংলা) & English.
- **Contact / Operator Hotline**: 01316314566 (+8801316314566)
- **Email**: contact@koyjabo.com

## Core Transit Modes Covered
1. **Dhaka Local Bus**: 466+ registered routes, 200+ operators, 2,412 stops, and route search.
2. **Dhaka Metro Rail (MRT Line-6)**: 17 operational stations from Uttara North to Motijheel, 32-minute traversal, and Rapid Pass discounts.
3. **Bangladesh Railway**: 255 intercity and commuter trains across 440+ stations nationwide.
4. **Intercity Bus**: Long-distance highway operators, counter phone numbers, and booking links.
5. **Truck & Logistics Freight**: Nationwide 7-ton to 15-ton truck rental and covered van logistics pricing.
6. **River Launch**: Sadarghat launch terminal departures to Barishal, Bhola, and southern riverine ports.
7. **Domestic Air**: Flight schedules for Hazrat Shahjalal (DAC), Shah Amanat (CGP), Osmani (ZYL), and Cox's Bazar (CXB).

# 1. Dhaka Metro Rail (MRT-6) Official Benchmark & Guide
Station coordinates, travel times, and fare schedules validated against DMTCL (Dhaka Mass Transit Company Limited) published circulars.,Distance measurements calculated from track centerlines.

### 32 Minutes — Total Travel Time
Dhaka Metro Rail MRT-6 connects Uttara North to Motijheel in exactly 32 minutes, bypassing hours of street-level traffic gridlock.
Context: 100 km/h design speed with high-density automated frequency.

### ৳20 – ৳100 — Fare Spectrum
Official single-journey fares start at ৳20 for adjacent stations and cap at ৳100 for end-to-end traversal from Uttara North to Kamalapur.
Context: Rapid Pass and MRT Pass cardholders receive an automatic 10% discount on every journey.

### 60,000 / Hour — Peak Hourly Capacity
MRT Line-6 is engineered to transport up to 60,000 passengers per hour in each direction during peak transit operations.
Context: 6-coach electric train sets with dedicated women-only coaches.

---
# 2. Dhaka Bus Transit Empirical Dataset & Statistics
Data collected via direct route GPS mapping, BRTA gazette notifications, and operator timetables across all 64 wards of Dhaka.,Only operational bus services with active route permits running as of 2026 are included in this benchmark.,Stop counts reflect distinct designated passenger boarding and dropping points along both directions.

### 100% — Non-AC Route Dominance
466 of 466 registered Dhaka bus routes (100%) operate strictly without air conditioning, leaving only 0 routes (0%) with AC options.
Context: Based on active route permits and commuter schedules analyzed across Dhaka Metropolitan Area.

### 16.2 — Average Stops per Route
The average Dhaka city bus serves 16.2 intermediate stops from origin to destination terminal.
Context: Measured across all 200+ distinct bus companies serving Dhaka and suburbs.

### 144 Routes — Busiest Transit Junction
Shahbag is Dhaka's most interconnected public transit junction, served by 144 passing bus routes.
Context: Intersection point for north-south and east-west Dhaka commuter corridors.

### 49 Stops — Longest Network Route
Ajmeri Glory is the single route with the highest stop density, spanning 49 registered stops.
Context: Inter-district commuter service connecting suburban zones to central commercial districts.

---
# 3. Bangladesh Railway Nationwide Transit Benchmark
Station records verified against Bangladesh Railway timetable, live train telemetry feed, and national GIS database.,Only stations actively serving passenger boarding in 2026 are counted in the active directory.

### 534 — Active Railway Stations
Bangladesh Railway operates across 534 active stations across the country, spanning East and West operational zones.
Context: Full rail network station directory verified from Bangladesh Railway telemetry.

### 255 — Intercity Train Routes
A scheduled network of 255 intercity train routes connects Dhaka with district headquarters across all 8 divisions.
Context: Exclusive of suburban commuter shuttles, mail trains, and goods freight trains.

### Dhaka – Chattogram — Busiest Rail Corridor
The Dhaka–Chattogram route (Suborna Express, Sonar Bangla Express, Mahanagar Provati) carries the highest annual passenger volume in Bangladesh Railway history.
Context: Over 320 km double-track electrified and automatic-signaled corridor.
